Метионин.about: All three meta-analyses on methionine are about dairy cows, not people; for a person as a supplement there is no data in the pool.
Метионин.caution: Doses and effects cannot be transferred from dairy cows to humans: these animals use methionine to synthesize milk protein.
Метионин.course: not specified in abstracts for humans; in cows the optimal duration is 68-72 days
Метионин.food_sources: In the pool abstracts, food sources for humans are not discussed: all three meta-analyses are about feeding dairy cows.
Метионин.guidelines: There are no methionine recommendations for humans in the pool: only meta-analyses on dairy cow productivity are available.
Метионин.how_to_choose: There is nothing to choose: there are no confirmed doses for humans, and the grams indicated in the meta-analyses are calculated for reverse-transition cows.
mechs: In experiments on dairy cows, methionine supplementation increased milk protein yield by 2.23 g per 1 g of metabolized methionine
Increase in milk protein in cows
Crude milk yield did not respond significantly to methionine, only protein responded
Milk protein is growing, milk yield is not
There is no data on the effect of methionine intake on humans in the pool
The effect of the supplement in humans has not been studied
Метионин.myths: “Meta-analysis proves benefits” - all three were carried out on methionine for dairy cows, they cannot be transferred to humans. “Improves strength” - there is not a single work on humans in the pool.
Метионин.name: Methionine
Метионин.onset: Response times have only been studied in cows: 68-72 days for protected methionine. Not studied in humans.
Метионин.title: Methionine
Метионин.who_needs: For no one, according to the pool: all three meta-analyses were performed on cows, none on humans.
